summary: The Realm of Discord is a war‑scarred dimension of broken geometry, planar corruption, and endless conflict. It is the origin of the Muramite Legion and the source of the rifts that consumed Kuua.

events: Discord formed as a dimensional fracture between hostile planes.
Chaotic energies shaped unstable landscapes and warped time.
Muramite warlords unified the fractured realm under brutal dominion.
Discordian forges created weapons capable of planar invasion.
Rifts opened into Kuua, leading to its collapse.
Muramite armies established footholds across Kuua’s regions.
Riftseekers attempted to contain Discord’s planar bleed.
Temporal fractures appeared across Discord and Kuua.
